messages:
zoe: Post-GA follow-up planning: we need to decide how to split fixes vs polish next week. My proposal: 3 quick bug patches (P1 crash, P2 data-sync, P3 minor UI flicker) + 2 small UX tweaks as a single micro-wave if owners are confident. Thoughts?
kevin: What's the max scope for a single micro-wave? We burned time last time because scope crept.
priya: Can we gate by risk rather than count? e.g., only include non-db migrations and only front-end/edge logic for the same wave.
zoe: Good call. Risk gate: no schema changes, no infra toggles, tests covering new flows. If any PR expands scope we defer to next wave.
kevin: Also prefer splitting crash-only canary first if crash patch touches runtime kernel. That isolates risk.
priya: Agreed. Crash patch needs runtime owner signoff and a 6h canary. The rest can follow in "wave-2" 24h later.
zoe: UX tweaks are small: guided prompt microcopy + compact onboarding CTA. Priya, can UX review and QA be done within 12h?
priya: Yes, will triage and batch the copy PRs. QA will add 3 acceptance flows. I'll tag dev-qa-bot.
dev-qa-bot: Added test matrix: long-prompt regression, onboarding flow, auth token refresh. Will run smoke on canary and full suite on promote.
kevin: Need observability plan: token error rate, p99 latency, support ticket spike. If any of these deviate beyond threshold we rollback.
zoe: Thresholds: error rate >1.5% OR p99 +250ms -> rollback. Support tickets alarm if >30 incoming mentions in 6h.
priya: Timeline suggestion: Day1 morning: canary/crash-only. If green -> Day2 early: wave-2 with data-sync patch + UX. Deploy window 03:00 PT.
dev-qa-bot: Canary smoke run scheduled: canary/4345678910-1. Results posted in #eng-runtime.
deploy-bot: Recommended release plan created. Manual promotes required by zoe + kevin. I will annotate the changelog.
zoe: I'll open backlog items: micro/4345678910-crash, micro/4345678910-sync, micro/4345678910-ux. Owners: kevin (crash), priya (sync + ux). Quick sync 10:30 to lock freezes. Thanks. :rocket:
